Archmage '''Ur''' was a mage of [[Dalaran (kingdom)|Dalaran]] who lived during the events of the [[Third War]]. He is the eponymous author of the [[Book of Ur]] and the [[Book of Ur: Volume Two]], as well as [[Vorgendor: Myths from the Blood Dimension]] and [['On the Powers of Blood']], which delve into the nature of blood magic and the origin of the [[worgen]]. Ur perished during the Scourge's assault on Dalaran.<ref name=":0">{{Questlong|Horde|26|The Book of Ur}}</ref>

The first volume of Ur would end up in the possession of [[Archmage Arugal]] of [[Shadowfang Keep]] until Horde adventurers retrieved the book for [[Keeper Bel'dugur]].<ref name=":0" />

The second volume was taken from the library of [[Gilneas City]] on behalf of [[Ethan Ravencroft]], a member of the [[Lupine Coven]].<ref>{{Questlong|Alliance|45|Ravencroft's Ambition}}</ref>

The related book, Vorgendor: Myths from the Blood Dimension, was lost in the depths of [[Upper Karazhan]] until adventurers retrieved and brought it to [[Arch Druid Dreamwind]], who was researching the [[Scythe of Elune]].<ref>{{Questlong|Neutral|60|Scythe of the Goddess}}</ref>

'On the Powers of Blood' was held by the [[Regent-Lords of Gilneas]], [[Regent-Lady Celia Harlow|Celia]] and [[Regent-Lord Mortimer Harlow|Mortimer Harlow]], and was retrieved from [[Greymane Tower]] by a Horde adventurer for [[Orvan Darkeye]].<ref name="All We Need Is Blood" />

Ur also wrote the esoteric tome [[Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic]], which was safeguarded by the [[Wizard's Sanctum]] in [[Stormwind City|Stormwind]] until it was absconded with by the warlock [[Morganth]]. [[High Sorcerer Andromath]], fearing Morganth would find a way to open the spell-sealed tome, instructed Alliance mages to return the book.<ref>{{Questlong|Alliance|26|Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic|class=Mage}}</ref>
